parsed.basis: Just common sense and courtesy: give an elderly person room to pass in a narrow, busy passage and greet someone I know. No law, study or specific guidance was in mind.
parsed.applies_to: All four decisions, especially letting Person 1 pass and greeting her.
parsed.side_detail: I first moved left to open a lane since she was heading opposite and drifting toward my left, but as she kept drifting that way and I was getting close to the left wall, I shifted a little right to keep a clear gap and stay off the wall.
